"""Build and verify a single research-only, retrospective fixed-basket label."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import traceback
from pathlib import Path

import joblib
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits

ROOT = Path("/Users/yuxianqi/Project/qlib")
WORK = Path("/tmp/qlib-forward-spreads-20261112.Wl6xmg")
ARCHIVE = ROOT / "backtest/experiments/models/train-data/dft-specialists-20261108-v1/extensions/forward-spread-20261112"
OLD = ROOT / "backtest/experiments/models/model-structure/style-classifier-k4-20261108-v1"
PROVIDER = ROOT / "backtest/result/20261103_h20_causal_inputs/evaluation-provider"
OLD_TARGET = ROOT / "backtest/experiments/models/training-target/label-grading-p50-20261106-v1/data/quantile10-old.pkl"
DAILY_SOURCE = OLD / "data/daily-market.parquet"
LEGACY_AUDIT = OLD / "docs/label-audit.json"
FORWARD_SOURCE = ARCHIVE / "data/quotes/forward.parquet"
SPREADS = ["small_big", "lowvol_highvol", "momentum"]
COLS = ["mkt", "mkt_vol", *SPREADS]
CUTOFF = pd.Timestamp("2020-07-31")
EVAL_FROM = pd.Timestamp("2020-08-03")
EVAL_TO = pd.Timestamp("2026-07-23")
NAMES = list("DFTP")

def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text())

def save(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tmp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    tmp.replace(path)

def fingerprint(path):
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
    return {"path":str(path), "sha256":digest, "size":path.stat().st_size}

def date_text(value):
    return pd.Timestamp(value).date().isoformat()

def distribution(x):
    return {k:int(x.eq(k).sum()) for k in NAMES}

def ledger(*args):
    subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(WORK/"ledger.py"),*map(str,args)],check=True,cwd=ROOT)

def inputs():
    fwd=pd.read_parquet(FORWARD_SOURCE)
    assert fingerprint(FORWARD_SOURCE)["sha256"]=="df2846afedeef9f19888c36c929602e1680718a3a28a7cdf2fd58fd02f739a75"
    legacy=read(LEGACY_AUDIT)
    assert fingerprint(DAILY_SOURCE)["sha256"]==legacy["inputs"]["daily_market"]["sha256"]
    daily=pd.read_parquet(DAILY_SOURCE)
    cal=pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime((PROVIDER/"calendars/day.txt").read_text().splitlines()))
    assert cal.is_unique and cal.is_monotonic_increasing
    assert fwd.index.equals(cal[(cal>=fwd.index[0])&(cal<=fwd.index[-1])])
    assert fwd.index.is_unique and fwd.index.is_monotonic_increasing and len(fwd)==5724
    dates=cal.get_indexer(fwd.index)
    for h in [5,20]:
        assert np.isfinite(fwd[[f"{s}_h{h}" for s in SPREADS]]).all().all()
        assert pd.DatetimeIndex(fwd[f"exit_h{h}"]).equals(cal[dates+h+1])
    assert daily.mkt.loc[fwd.index].notna().all()
    return fwd,daily,cal,legacy

def make_periods(fwd,daily,cal,stage):
    freq_name,h_str=stage.split("-h")
    h=int(h_str)
    freq="M" if freq_name=="monthly" else "W-FRI"
    full_key=cal.to_period(freq)
    source_key=fwd.index.to_period(freq)
    calendar_count=pd.Series(1,index=cal).groupby(full_key).sum()
    count=pd.Series(1,index=fwd.index).groupby(source_key).sum()
    complete=count.eq(calendar_count.loc[count.index])
    valid=count.index[complete]
    keys=pd.Series(source_key,index=fwd.index)
    date_key=keys[keys.isin(valid)]
    z=fwd[[f"{s}_h{h}" for s in SPREADS]].copy()
    z.columns=SPREADS
    x=z.groupby(source_key).mean().loc[valid].copy()
    mkt=daily.mkt.astype("float64")
    returns=mkt.loc[fwd.index]
    x["mkt"]=returns.groupby(source_key).sum().loc[valid]
    if freq_name=="monthly":
        x["mkt_vol"]=returns.groupby(source_key).std(ddof=1).loc[valid]
    else:
        daily_vol=mkt.rolling(5,min_periods=5).std(ddof=1).loc[fwd.index]
        x["mkt_vol"]=daily_vol.groupby(source_key).last().loc[valid]
    bounds=pd.DataFrame({"signal":fwd.index,"ready_date":fwd[f"exit_h{h}"]})
    meta=bounds.groupby(source_key).agg(first=("signal","min"),last=("signal","max"),ready_date=("ready_date","max"),signal_days=("signal","size")).loc[valid]
    assert meta.index.equals(x.index)
    assert (meta.ready_date.to_numpy()>meta["last"].to_numpy()).all()
    assert np.isfinite(x[COLS]).all().all()
    excluded={str(k):{"actual":int(count[k]),"calendar":int(calendar_count[k])} for k in count.index[~complete]}
    assert all(k in (count.index[0],count.index[-1]) for k in count.index[~complete])
    return x[COLS],meta,date_key,excluded

def semantic_flags(raw, mapping):
    c={name:dict(zip(COLS,map(float,raw[i]))) for i,name in mapping.items()}
    return {
        "T_large_amount_leads":c["T"]["small_big"]<0,
        "T_high_vol_leads":c["T"]["lowvol_highvol"]<0,
        "T_positive_momentum":c["T"]["momentum"]>0,
        "T_largest_momentum":c["T"]["momentum"]==max(r["momentum"] for r in c.values()),
        "D_low_amount_and_low_vol_lead":c["D"]["small_big"]>0 and c["D"]["lowvol_highvol"]>0,
        "F_market_positive_and_momentum_negative":c["F"]["mkt"]>0 and c["F"]["momentum"]<0,
        "P_market_lowest_and_negative":c["P"]["mkt"]==min(r["mkt"] for r in c.values()) and c["P"]["mkt"]<0,
        "P_market_vol_above_median":bool(c["P"]["mkt_vol"]>np.median([r["mkt_vol"] for r in c.values()])),
    }

def materialize(stage,fwd,daily,cal,legacy,folder):
    x,meta,date_key,excluded=make_periods(fwd,daily,cal,stage)
    mask=meta.ready_date.le(CUTOFF)
    xtrain=x.loc[mask]
    assert len(xtrain)>100 and (meta.loc[mask,"last"]<CUTOFF).all()
    ref=Path(legacy["model"]["path"])
    assert fingerprint(ref)["sha256"]==legacy["model"]["sha256"]
    ref_model=joblib.load(ref)["kmeans"]
    with threadpool_limits(limits=1):
        scaler=StandardScaler().fit(xtrain)
        model=KMeans(n_clusters=4,random_state=42,n_init=100).fit(scaler.transform(xtrain))
        raw=model.predict(scaler.transform(x))
    cost=((model.cluster_centers_[:,None,:]-ref_model.cluster_centers_[None,:,:])**2).sum(axis=2)
    row,col=linear_sum_assignment(cost)
    mapping={int(i):legacy["mapping"][str(j)] for i,j in zip(row,col)}
    assert set(mapping.values())==set(NAMES) and model.n_init==100
    assert np.array_equal(raw[mask],model.labels_)
    assert np.allclose(scaler.mean_,xtrain.to_numpy(dtype="float64").mean(axis=0),rtol=1e-12,atol=1e-13)
    periods=meta.assign(raw_cluster=raw,style4=pd.Series(raw,index=x.index).map(mapping),fit_period=mask)
    periods["style3"]=periods.style4.replace("P","D")
    periods=pd.concat([periods,x],axis=1)
    dates=pd.DataFrame({"period":date_key.astype(str),"style4":date_key.map(periods.style4),"style3":date_key.map(periods.style3),"ready_date":date_key.map(periods.ready_date)})
    dates.index.name="datetime"
    assert not dates.isna().any().any() and dates.index.is_unique and dates.index.is_monotonic_increasing
    assert (dates.ready_date.to_numpy()>dates.index.to_numpy()).all()
    e=dates.loc[EVAL_FROM:EVAL_TO]
    assert len(e)==1448 and e.index.equals(cal[(cal>=EVAL_FROM)&(cal<=EVAL_TO)])
    row_counts=pd.read_pickle(OLD_TARGET).groupby(level="datetime").size()
    train=dates.loc[row_counts.index]
    h20_exit=pd.Series(cal[cal.get_indexer(train.index)+21],index=train.index)
    used=train[train.ready_date.le(CUTOFF)&h20_exit.le(CUTOFF)]
    train_counts={s:{"days":int(used.style4.eq(s).sum()),"rows":int(row_counts.reindex(used.index)[used.style4.eq(s)].sum())} for s in NAMES}
    assert set(used.style3)==set("DFT")
    modelpath=folder/"data/label-model.joblib"
    datepath=folder/"data/date-labels.csv"
    periodpath=folder/"data/period-labels.csv"
    for out in [modelpath,datepath,periodpath]:
        assert not out.exists(),out
        out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    joblib.dump({"scaler":scaler,"model":model,"feature_names":COLS,"semantic_mapping":mapping},modelpath)
    periods.to_csv(periodpath,index_label="period",float_format="%.17g")
    dates[["style4","style3","ready_date","period"]].to_csv(datepath,index_label="datetime")
    saved=joblib.load(modelpath)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(saved["model"].predict(saved["scaler"].transform(x)),raw)
    rt=pd.read_csv(datepath,index_col="datetime",parse_dates=["datetime","ready_date"])
    pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(rt,dates[rt.columns],check_freq=False)
    restored=pd.read_csv(periodpath,index_col="period",float_precision="round_trip")
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(restored[COLS].to_numpy(),x.to_numpy())
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(saved["model"].predict(saved["scaler"].transform(restored[COLS])),raw)
    center=scaler.inverse_transform(model.cluster_centers_)
    report={"stage":stage,"outcome":"succeeded","n_init":100,"seed":42,"kmeans_fits":1,"scaler_fits":1,"feature_names":COLS,
            "fit_rule":"Exact complete signal periods with last basket exit <= 2020-07-31; no evaluation features used for scale/centers. Each period one fit observation.",
            "fit_periods":len(xtrain),"all_periods":len(x),"max_fit_ready_date":date_text(meta.loc[mask,"ready_date"].max()),"last_fit_period":str(xtrain.index[-1]),
            "first_signal_date":date_text(dates.index[0]),"last_signal_date":date_text(dates.index[-1]),"first_omitted_incomplete_periods":excluded,
            "period_features":"Sum realized same-period daily market returns; monthly market volatility sample sd inside month, weekly volatility last-day rolling 5-day sample sd; three forward spread features are mean cumulative H fixed-basket spread across that period's signal dates. Units decimal.",
            "mapping_rule":"Hungarian squared Euclidean distance in each fit's standardized space to historical frozen originally full-history monthly reference. Naming convention is retrospective; new centers/scaler limited to mature training periods.",
            "mapping":mapping,"reference_centers_standardized":ref_model.cluster_centers_.tolist(),"squared_distances":cost.tolist(),"reference":fingerprint(ref),
            "trained_centers_standardized":model.cluster_centers_.tolist(),"trained_centers_raw_by_style":{mapping[i]:dict(zip(COLS,map(float,center[i]))) for i in range(4)},
            "economic_direction_checks":semantic_flags(center,mapping),"scaler_mean":scaler.mean_.tolist(),"scaler_scale":scaler.scale_.tolist(),
            "train_canonical_days_before_maturity_filter":len(train),"train_eligible_days":len(used),"train_eligible_by_style4":train_counts,
            "train_omitted_immature_rows":int(row_counts.reindex(train.index[train.ready_date.gt(CUTOFF)]).sum()),"train_omitted_immature_days":int(train.ready_date.gt(CUTOFF).sum()),
            "train_omitted_either_boundary_rows":int(row_counts.sum()-row_counts.reindex(used.index).sum()),"train_omitted_either_boundary_days":len(train)-len(used),
            "train_eligible_rule":"Signal is an existing v5 training date; both period label ready_date and t+21 H20 individual-stock target exit must be <= 2020-07-31.",
            "evaluation_counts":distribution(e.style4),"all_counts":distribution(dates.style4),"fit_period_counts":distribution(periods.loc[mask,"style4"]),
            "signal_and_ready_ranges_eval":[date_text(e.index.min()),date_text(e.index.max()),date_text(e.ready_date.min()),date_text(e.ready_date.max())],
            "input_fingerprints":[fingerprint(i) for i in [DAILY_SOURCE,FORWARD_SOURCE,LEGACY_AUDIT,PROVIDER/"calendars/day.txt",OLD_TARGET]],
            "saved_model":fingerprint(modelpath),"date_labels":fingerprint(datepath),"period_labels":fingerprint(periodpath),
            "reload_verification":"Persisted model+scaler predict every original/CSV period label, persisted complete dates and maturity fields match.",
            "period_labels_diagnostic":"Peer labels within a week or month use the same ready_date; they cannot be known on an earlier signal day."}
    save(folder/"docs/label-fit.json",report)
    return report

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("stage",choices=["monthly-h5","monthly-h20","weekly-h5","weekly-h20"])
    parser.add_argument("--preflight-only",action="store_true")
    args=parser.parse_args()
    folder=ARCHIVE/"stages"/args.stage
    fwd,daily,cal,legacy=inputs()
    x,meta,keys,excluded=make_periods(fwd,daily,cal,args.stage)
    print(args.stage,len(x),int(meta.ready_date.le(CUTOFF).sum()),excluded,flush=True)
    if args.preflight_only:return
    assert not (folder/"docs/label-fit.json").exists() and not (folder/"data/label-model.joblib").exists()
    ledger("label-start",args.stage)
    try:
        report=materialize(args.stage,fwd,daily,cal,legacy,folder)
    except BaseException as err:
        error=folder/"docs/label-failure.json";save(error,{"stage":args.stage,"error":repr(err),"traceback":traceback.format_exc()})
        ledger("label-result",args.stage,"failed",error)
        raise
    ledger("label-result",args.stage,"succeeded",folder/"docs/label-fit.json")
    print(args.stage,report["evaluation_counts"],flush=True)

if __name__=="__main__":
    main()
